## Breaking Change:

Python 3.6.0 is going to be deprecated in Home Assistant 0.99 in favor of Python 3.6.1. Reason is that an important upstream Python dependency has required a minimum version of Python 3.6.1.

## Description:

Fix: #26567

issue_context.title: Deprecate  Python 3.6.0
issue_context.body:
Python 3.6.0 is going to be deprecated in Home Assistant 0.99 in favor of Python 3.6.1. Reason is that an important upstream Python dependency (`websockets`) has required a minimum version of Python 3.6.1.

Related issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/pull/280

We should print a warning if a user is running 3.6.0 of this upcoming change.

review_comments: Can you also log it? That way it shows up in error logs
